svg.title: Figure 2-1. DFA initiators against the ASIL decompositions
svg.desc: Dependent failure analysis LD-DFA-001 rev 0.16 against FSC rev 0.5: 21 dependent failure initiators, DFI-01a to DFI-36 (the WP-A-03 numbers of those that reach a panda/SoC decomposition), in 13 categories mapped onto 11 ASIL decompositions. Initiators: 4 insufficient, 14 open, 3 safe by design. Decompositions: 10 not accepted, 1 not assessable. 25 measures with their status (10 required) and the DFA open items.

Firmware authenticity: panda bootloader accepts only signed LionDriver release
firmware, rejects downgrade, and flashing is allowed only offroad.
Separate release gate for panda firmware and safety model (safety test suite, HIL,
independent review), versioned independently of SoC software.
Envelope derived from vehicle measurements independently of opendbc, with both
channels' limits checked against it. For steering, authority limits derived physically
per speed from controllability (lead decision DQ-007 C). Every limit derived
independently of the controller tuning, with the controller set lower (lead decision
Panda blocks assist-active HUD and status bits when controls are not allowed.
Reference build: LKAS_HUD with BARRIERS != 0 refused unless controls are allowed
or were allowed within 1 s. Unit-tested; not verified on the vehicle.
Panda accepts diagnostic (ELM327) mode only offroad. Reference build: ELM327
refused once the car mode has been accepted, until the ignition is off (LD-DES-001
DR-05 without the stationary alternative). Unit-tested; HIL not run.

Bench tests of the harness box failure behaviour: box unpowered with camera and
car powered (pass-through continuity, CAN0/CAN2 levels), pull-down open, supply
stress (WP-H-06 VS-HW-22, VS-HW-23, VS-HW-24; DFMEA DFM-ACT-014).
A safety-mode change does not undo the panda's fault reactions: after a mode
change authority needs cruise off and on again (DQ-080, SWSR-311), a TX-rate
revocation persists (DQ-079, SWSR-518), and the EPS-fault, RX-check and
relay-malfunction states are re-established before a grant; or the reference lock
refuses re-entry to TOYOTA in the same ignition cycle while cruise is on. In the
pinned code and unit-tested: the new engagement, the TX-rate block and the
jherrodthomas/opendbc#15); the relay malfunction latched for the ignition cycle,

The panda releases the ELM327 lock (DM-12) only on an ignition-off confirmed by a
second source, for example no vehicle CAN traffic or zero vehicle speed for a set
time, not on the harness ignition line alone.
